def factor_volume_intensity_streak(df):
    df_copy = df.copy()
    vol_ma = df_copy["volume"].rolling(50, min_periods=1).mean()
    vol_ratio = df_copy["volume"] / vol_ma
    high_vol = vol_ratio > 1.5
    excess = (vol_ratio - 1.0).where(high_vol, 0.0)
    group = (high_vol != high_vol.shift(1)).cumsum()
    streak_excess = excess.groupby(group).cumsum()
    df_copy["factor_volume_intensity_streak"] = streak_excess
    return df_copy["factor_volume_intensity_streak"]
description: Mutation simplifies the parent (volume intensity streak with directional persistence) by removing the up-day fraction multiplier. The core mechanism - cumulative excess volume during consecutive high-volume days - is preserved. This ablation aims to improve robustness and generalizability by discarding a modifier that may add noise or overfit to specific market regimes.
